units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 20. If an electronic tender is declared unsuccessful in the cases provided for in Article 52(1) of this Federal Law, it shall be conducted subject to the specific rules established by Article 52(2)–(4) and (7) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 20 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.label: Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: 1. An electronic auction begins with the posting of a procurement notice in the unified information system. The application must contain the information and documents specified in Article 43(1) of this Federal Law: point 1, subpoints “м”–“п”; point 2, subpoints “а”–“в”; and point 5. It may also contain the information and documents specified in Article 43(1)(2)(д) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: 2. Participants that have submitted applications under this Federal Law may, during the procedure for submitting offers of the contract price or the total of unit prices of goods, works or services (in the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law), use the electronic platform to submit price offers reducing (except in the case provided for in paragraph 3(9) of this Article) the initial (maximum) contract price or the initial total of unit prices of goods, works or services (in the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law).
units.label: Part 2 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: 3. Price offers shall be submitted in the following procedure:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: 1) a price offer is submitted by reducing the current lowest price offer by an amount from 0.5 per cent to 5 per cent of the initial (maximum) contract price or the initial total of unit prices of goods, works or services (in the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law) (hereinafter, the “auction step”);
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: 2) a participant may not submit a price offer:
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: а) equal to zero;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 2 Part 3 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: б) equal to or higher than a price offer previously submitted by that participant;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 2 Part 3 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: в) lower than the current lowest price offer reduced within the “auction step”;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 2 Part 3 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: г) lower than the current lowest price offer if that offer was submitted by the same participant;
units.label: Subpoint «г» Point 2 Part 3 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: 3) a price offer may be submitted independently of the “auction step”, provided the requirements of point 2 of this paragraph are met;
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: 4) the electronic platform operator shall automatically reject through the platform price offers that do not meet this paragraph’s requirements. Price offers may not be rejected on other grounds;
units.label: Point 4 Part 3 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: 5) the period for accepting price offers is four minutes from the start of the price-offer procedure. If an offer meeting points 1 and 2 of this paragraph is received during that period, the platform shall automatically extend the acceptance period to four minutes from receipt of that offer. The total duration of acceptance of price offers must not exceed five hours from the start of the procedure;
units.label: Point 5 Part 3 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: 6) within ten minutes after the acceptance period specified in point 5 of this paragraph ends, a participant may submit one price offer no lower than the lowest offer received during the acceptance period specified in point 5 of this paragraph. The offer must meet point 2, subpoints “а”, “б” and “г”, of this paragraph and may be submitted independently of the “auction step”;
units.label: Point 6 Part 3 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: 7) the electronic platform operator shall display on the platform all submitted price offers and their receipt times without identifying the participants that submitted them, and the remaining time for accepting offers;
units.label: Point 7 Part 3 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: 8) if a participant has not submitted a price offer, its lowest offer is deemed to be the initial (maximum) contract price or the initial total of unit prices of goods, works or services (in the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law);
units.label: Point 8 Part 3 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: 9) if, during the price-offer procedure, an offer reduces the contract price or total of unit prices of goods, works or services (in the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law) to one half of one per cent of the initial (maximum) contract price or initial total of unit prices (in the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law), or below, the procedure shall continue as bidding for the right to conclude the contract under this paragraph, subject to the following specific rules:
units.label: Point 9 Part 3 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: а) the procedure shall determine the fee payable by the participant for conclusion of the contract. That amount shall be stated as the contract price in accordance with this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 9 Part 3 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: б) participants may submit price offers increasing the offer specified in the first subparagraph of this point;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 9 Part 3 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: в) price offers shall be submitted by increasing the current highest price offer by an amount within the “auction step”, up to five million roubles;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 9 Part 3 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: г) Repealed from 1 January 2023. — Federal Law of 16.04.2022 No. 104-FZ.
units.label: Subpoint «г» Point 9 Part 3 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: 4. No later than one hour after the price-offer procedure ends, the electronic platform operator shall:
units.label: Part 4 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: 1) rank each procurement application in ascending order of the contract price or the total of unit prices of goods, works or services (in the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law) offered by its applicant, except in the case provided for in paragraph 3(9) of this Article, where applications of participants that submitted offers after the offer specified in the first subparagraph of point 9 of paragraph 3 shall be ranked in descending order of the contract price or total of unit prices of goods, works or services (in the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law). Where several participants submit identical price offers, the application of the participant that submitted its price offer earlier shall receive the lower rank number. When ranking applications submitted without price offers, the application received earlier than the other such applications shall receive the lower rank number;
units.label: Point 1 Part 4 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: 2) prepare a record of price offers containing:
units.label: Point 2 Part 4 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: а) the date and the starting and ending times of the price-offer procedure;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 2 Part 4 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: б) the lowest price offer, or the highest price offer in the case provided for in paragraph 3(9) of this Article, submitted by each participant, indicating its application identification number, the time the offer was submitted, and the dates and times of submission of applications from participants that did not submit price offers;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 2 Part 4 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: в) the ranks assigned to applications under point 1 of this paragraph;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 2 Part 4 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: 3) post the record provided for in point 2 of this paragraph in the unified information system and on the electronic platform;
units.label: Point 3 Part 4 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: 4) send the contracting authority the record provided for in point 2 of this paragraph, the procurement applications, and the information and documents specified in Article 43(6)(2) and (3) of this Federal Law concerning the participants that submitted them.
units.label: Point 4 Part 4 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: 5. No later than two working days from the day following the application deadline, but no later than the date for determining the results of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection set in the procurement notice:
units.label: Part 5 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: 1) members of the procurement commission:
units.label: Point 1 Part 5 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: а) examine the applications, information and documents sent by the electronic platform operator under paragraph 4(4) of this Article and decide whether an application complies with the procurement notice or must be rejected on grounds specified in Article 48(12)(1)–(8) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 1 Part 5 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: б) on the basis of the price-offer record and the results of examination under subpoint “а” of this point, rank each application found to comply with the procurement notice in ascending order of its applicant’s lowest price offer, except in the case provided for in paragraph 3(9) of this Article, where applications of participants that submitted offers after the offer specified in the first subparagraph of paragraph 3(9) of this Article shall be ranked in descending order of their price offers, and taking account of regulatory legal acts adopted under Article 14 of this Federal Law. The application of the winner of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection shall be ranked first;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 1 Part 5 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: 2) the contracting authority shall use the electronic platform to prepare the record of the results of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection, containing the information specified in Article 48(17)(1), (2) and (4)–(7) of this Federal Law. After the procurement commission members sign it with enhanced electronic signatures, the contracting authority shall sign it with the enhanced electronic signature of a person authorized to act on its behalf and send it to the electronic platform operator.
units.label: Point 2 Part 5 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: 6. No later than one hour after receiving the record of the results of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection sent under paragraph 5(2) of this Article, the electronic platform operator shall post:
units.label: Part 6 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: 1) in the unified information system and on the electronic platform, the record of the results of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection;
units.label: Point 1 Part 6 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: 2) in the unified information system, the information specified in Article 43(1)(1), subpoints “а” and “е”, of this Federal Law, the entry numbers in the unified register of procurement participants for participants whose applications were found to comply with the procurement notice, and the identification numbers of those applications. The information specified in this subpoint shall not be published on the official website.
units.label: Point 2 Part 6 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: 7. A participant that took part in the procurement may, after the price-offer record is posted in the unified information system under paragraph 4(3) of this Article but no later than the date of conclusion of the contract, use the electronic platform to ask its operator for clarification of the price-offer procedure as it relates to that participant’s offer. The operator shall send the relevant clarification to the participant through the platform no later than two working days following receipt of the request.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: 8. The submission, where necessary, by a participant that took part in the procurement of a request for clarification of information in the record of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results concerning its application, and the sending of the relevant clarification to that participant, shall follow the procedure provided for in Article 48(18) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Conduct of an electronic auction
units.text: 9. If an electronic auction is declared unsuccessful in the cases provided for in Article 52(1) of this Federal Law, it shall be conducted subject to the specific rules established by Article 52(2), (5) and (7) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 50. Conduct of an electronic request for quotations
units.text: Article 50. Conduct of an electronic request for quotations
units.label: Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Conduct of an electronic request for quotations
units.text: 1. An electronic request for quotations begins with the posting of a procurement notice in the unified information system. The application must contain the information and documents specified in Article 43(1) of this Federal Law: point 1, subpoints “м”–“п”; point 2, subpoints “а”–“в”; point 3 or point 4; and point 5. It may also contain the information and documents specified in Article 43(1)(2)(д) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Conduct of an electronic request for quotations
units.text: 2. No later than one hour after the application deadline, the electronic platform operator shall, under Article 43(6)(9) of this Federal Law, send the contracting authority the applications and the information and documents specified in Article 43(6)(2) and (3) of this Federal Law concerning the participants that submitted them.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Conduct of an electronic request for quotations
units.text: 3. No later than two working days from the day following the application deadline, but no later than the date for determining the results of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection, as set in the procurement notice:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Conduct of an electronic request for quotations
units.text: 1) members of the procurement commission:
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Conduct of an electronic request for quotations
units.text: а) examine the applications, information and documents sent by the electronic platform operator under paragraph 2 of this Article and decide whether an application complies with the procurement notice or must be rejected on grounds specified in Article 48(12)(1)–(8) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 1 Part 3 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Conduct of an electronic request for quotations
units.text: б) on the basis of the decision under subpoint “а” of this point, rank each application found to comply with the procurement notice in ascending order of the contract price or the total of unit prices of goods, works or services (in the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law) offered by its applicant, taking account of regulatory legal acts adopted under Article 14 of this Federal Law. The application of the winner of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection shall be ranked first. Where several applications contain identical offers under Article 43(1), point 3 or 4, of this Federal Law, the application received earlier shall receive the lower rank number;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 1 Part 3 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Conduct of an electronic request for quotations
units.text: 2) the contracting authority shall use the electronic platform to prepare the record of the results of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection, containing the information specified in Article 48(17)(1), (2) and (4)–(7) of this Federal Law. After the procurement commission members sign it with enhanced electronic signatures, the contracting authority shall sign it with the enhanced electronic signature of a person authorized to act on its behalf and send it to the electronic platform operator.
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Conduct of an electronic request for quotations
units.text: 4. No later than one hour after receiving the record of the results of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection sent under paragraph 3(2) of this Article, the electronic platform operator shall post:
units.label: Part 4 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Conduct of an electronic request for quotations
units.text: 1) in the unified information system and on the electronic platform, the record of the results of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection;
units.label: Point 1 Part 4 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Conduct of an electronic request for quotations
units.text: 2) in the unified information system, the information specified in Article 43(1)(1), subpoints “а” and “е”, of this Federal Law, the entry numbers in the unified register of procurement participants for participants whose applications were found to comply with the procurement notice, and the identification numbers of those applications. The information specified in this subpoint shall not be published on the official website.
units.label: Point 2 Part 4 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Conduct of an electronic request for quotations
units.text: 5. The submission, where necessary, by a participant that took part in the procurement of a request for clarification of information in the record of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results concerning its application, and the sending of the relevant clarification to that participant, shall follow the procedure provided for in Article 48(18) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Conduct of an electronic request for quotations
units.text: 6. A contract following an electronic request for quotations shall be concluded in the procedure established by Article 51 of this Federal Law, subject to the following specific rules:
units.label: Part 6 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Conduct of an electronic request for quotations
units.text: 1) the contracting authority shall prepare and post the unsigned draft contract in the unified information system and on the electronic platform (using the unified information system) no later than one working day following the posting in the unified information system of the record of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results;
units.label: Point 1 Part 6 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Conduct of an electronic request for quotations
units.text: 2) the participant with whom the contract is to be concluded shall perform the actions specified in Article 51(3)(1) of this Federal Law no later than one working day following the contracting authority’s actions under point 1 of this paragraph;
units.label: Point 2 Part 6 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Conduct of an electronic request for quotations
units.text: 3) the contracting authority shall perform the actions specified in Article 51(4)(1) of this Federal Law no later than one working day following the actions of the participant with whom the contract is to be concluded under point 2 of this paragraph, but no earlier than two working days following the posting in the unified information system of the record of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results;
units.label: Point 3 Part 6 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Conduct of an electronic request for quotations
units.text: 4) the actions specified in Article 51, paragraph 2(2), paragraph 3(2), and paragraph 4(2) and (3), of this Federal Law are not permitted.
units.label: Point 4 Part 6 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Conduct of an electronic request for quotations
units.text: 7. If an electronic request for quotations is declared unsuccessful in the cases provided for in Article 52(1) of this Federal Law, it shall be conducted subject to the specific rules established by Article 52(6) and (7) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 51. Conclusion of a contract following an electronic procedure
units.text: Article 51. Conclusion of a contract following an electronic procedure
units.label: Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Conclusion of a contract following an electronic procedure
units.text: 1. Following an electronic procedure, a contract shall be concluded with the winner of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection or, in the cases provided for by this Federal Law, with another participant (hereinafter in this Article, the participant with whom the contract is to be concluded), no earlier than ten days, unless otherwise provided by this Federal Law, from the posting in the unified information system of the record of selection results or the record provided for in paragraph 6(2)(а) of this Article, after that participant provides contract performance security as required by this Federal Law, if the procurement notice requires it. Participants whose applications have not been withdrawn under this Federal Law must sign the contract in the procedure established by this Article.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Conclusion of a contract following an electronic procedure
units.text: 2. No later than two working days following the posting in the unified information system of the records specified in paragraph 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Conclusion of a contract following an electronic procedure
units.text: 1) the contracting authority shall use the unified information system to prepare and post, without its signature, the draft contract specified in Article 42(2)(5) of this Federal Law in the unified information system (without publication on the official website) and on the electronic platform (using the unified information system). The draft must contain:
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Conclusion of a contract following an electronic procedure
units.text: а) the information specified in Article 30(6) and Article 42(1)(1), (2), (5)–(8), (10), (17), (18) and (20) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 1 Part 2 Art. 51
